Themultipurposeclockgenerator(MCG)moduleprovidesseveralclocksourcechoices
fortheMCU.
Themodulecontainsafrequency-lockedloop(FLL)andaphase-lockedloop(PLL).The
FLLiscontrollablebyeitheraninternaloranexternalreferenceclock.ThePLLis
controllablebytheexternalreferenceclock.ThemodulecanselecteitheranFLLorPLL
